mounting./api/external: Register + RegisterBudgetRouter + RegisterSDRouter + RegisterSBRouter behind VerifyAuth (bearer token + AProfileId header), then per-route ACL; RegisterNoMiddleware mounted before auth
mounting./api/external/:typeApiParam: Register + RegisterBudgetRouter mounted a second time with the product type (sp|sb|sd) as a path segment; budget handlers read it from the path; the other handlers ignore it. Rows carry mountedAlsoUnder.
mounting./api/internal: RegisterNoAuth (health, read-db, migrate, test, portfolio migrate-users, bidding cron) mounted BEFORE VerifyAuthInternal, so those routes are unauthenticated; Register (auto, clone, api-interface) is behind TOKEN_INTERNAL
mounting./swagger: Swagger UI (not inventoried as a business route)

A few read paths were classified by name only and are marked in notes where doubtful.
